bugs.description: In safety-control-object.html, when viewing a place (场所) detail view, the reviewer (复核人) names should display correctly in the scan config table. Currently the reviewer column shows the internal user ID format like 'user_002' instead of the actual person name like '李四'. The reviewer data is stored in the scanConfig objects under a 'reviewers' array with name/phone fields. The table rendering code should use reviewer.name or reviewer.reviewerName instead of a raw ID.

In safety-control-object.html, when selecting a position level (员工层级) in the tree-select cascader for scan responsible person (扫码责任人), the selected users should sync correctly to the display. Currently when you select '领导层' users from the cascader dropdown, the selected value display shows empty or incorrect content. The tree-select cascader uses a three-level structure: unit type → department → individual users. The confirmScanCascader() function should properly extract and display selected user names.
